subject: patient1
description: TFS/FM front-end v1: per-band analytic signal (32 ERB-spaced gammatone bands) -> instantaneous frequency, IF std (instantaneous bandwidth), IF skew, FM slope up/down, envelope-IF coupling, inter-band PLV, envelope-to-TFS ratio. Hann-windowed 4096 frame, central 2048 samples. 352 base features + 3 multi-tau deltas + FM/PLV summaries. Replaces envelope-only baseline.

subject: patient1
description: v2 trimmed: 16 blocks x 32 bands (logE, log_IF, IF_dev, IF_std, FM_up, FM_dn, corr_env-IF, PLV gap1, sub_range, pos/neg_diff_max within frame, envelope*{IF_dev,FM_up,FM_dn,PLV} products, PLV gap2). Multi-tau (15,60). Drops the noisy IF_skew, log_if_std, ratio_env_tfs, sub_max/min/std, prod_E_ifstd/corrEI, plv_g4 from initial attempt. v1=0.0556.

subject: patient1
description: v3 hybrid: multi-window (1024/2048/4096) log + cube-root gammatone cochleagram BASE (192 raw + 2 taus + 1 acausal future = ~672 dim) plus TFS block from analytic signal (log_IF, IF_dev, IF_std, FM_up/down, corr_env-IF, PLV gap1/2, env*products) x (1 raw + 2 taus) = 1056 dim. v1=0.0556 (pure TFS), v2=0.0520. Now adds proven envelope substrate.

subject: patient1
description: v4 = v3 + HARMONIC-COINCIDENCE pitch (across-band sum of envelope-weighted Gaussian distance between IF and nearest f0-multiple per F0 candidate, 12 F0s) and CROSS-BAND log envelope PRODUCTS (12 pairs across 6 broadband compactions). Also widened envelope cochleagram to 48 bands. v3=0.0591.

subject: patient1
description: v5: keep multi-window envelope substrate (48 bands log+cube, multi-tau, acausal). TFS block: log_IF, IF_dev, IF_std, FM_up/dn, PLV gap1/2. ADD: envelope SHAPE (skew, kurt) per band, FAST AM POWER per band at 32/64/128/256 Hz (above ridge-FIR reach), PHASE-AMPLITUDE COUPLING (8 low-band phases x 8 mid/high-band envelopes), and explicit per-band FUTURE/PAST DELTAS on long-window logE (k=3,6,12). Dropped weak products/F0-comb. v3=0.0591, v4=0.0586.

subject: patient1
description: v7 = v6 + new FM POWER SPECTRUM per band at 4 rates (8/16/32/64 Hz, IF wobble — orthogonal to AM), and 4-rate-scale 2-D STMF Chi-Shamma envelopes on long log-cochleagram (rates 4,8 Hz x scales +-0.25). AM rate set kept at 4 (32/64/128/256 Hz). v5=0.0617, v6=0.0622.

subject: patient1
description: v6 = v5 + INTER-FRAME modulation filterbank: 4 Gabor band-pass envelopes (rates 2/4/6/10 Hz) on per-band long-window log envelope across frames. Adds 4 x 48 = 192 features. v5=0.0617.

subject: patient1
description: v7c = v6 + per-frame F0 estimate from IF harmonic-coincidence (log_f0 + strength + 12 candidate distribution + voicing) inside TFS block, and formant tracking (F1/F2/F3 location & amplitude soft-argmax) + their 1st diff + multi-tau on formants. ~50 new features. v6=0.0622.

subject: patient1
description: v8b: v7c + LATERAL INHIBITION (DoG across channels) HALF-WAVE RECTIFIED both signs (96 features), cross-channel spectral SHAPE statistics (std/skew/kurt, 3 features). Scattering-2 dropped (too slow). v7c=0.0627.

subject: patient1
description: v9 = v8b + SACF pitch periodicity (6 lags, envelope cross-product across phase-locked bands; nonlinear), CARDINAL VOWEL template similarities (8 vowels in F1/F2 channel space; Gaussian-similarity nonlinear) with 3-tau dynamics, and 6 BROADBAND log-energy RATIOS with 3-tau dynamics. v8b=0.0632.

subject: patient1
description: v11 = v10 + LEGENDRE polynomial trajectory coefficients (orders 1,2,3) of BOTH IF (amp-weighted, fc-normalized, PL-masked, 96 feats) and envelope (z-scored in-frame, 96 feats) per band — captures FM curvature/cubic and AM shape that mean/slope/moments miss. PLUS cross-band MIN/MAX of 8 broadband log-envelope compactions (28+28 pairs) + co-activation gate (28) + 2 taus = 252 nonlinear cross-band features. v8b=0.0632.

subject: patient1
description: v12 = v8b + PER-BAND ONSET/OFFSET RECTIFIERS (HWR(+/- d/dt logE) at scales k=1 and k=3 frames, on the 48-band 4096-window log cochleagram: 4*48=192 features) + cross-band SPECTRAL FLUX (sum and max of HWR onsets across bands at 2 scales: 4 features). Half-wave rectification is nonlinear in the bands so the ridge cannot synthesize this from the log-env features. STG onset responses are a known neural signature. v8b=0.0632, v11=0.0568 (regression from feature bloat — backed off and added a single biologically targeted structural addition).

subject: patient1
description: v13 = v12 + slower onset scales k=6 (200ms, prosody) and k=12 (400ms, syllable-rate) — total 8*48=384 onset/offset features. Flux scalar set expanded to 12 features (sum/max ONSET + sum OFFSET at 4 scales). DROPPED TFS multi-tau at 15 frames to free budget (kept tau=60 only). v12=0.0637 (new best, +0.0005 from onsets at fast scales). Testing whether slower prosodic onsets also predict STG.

subject: patient1
description: v14 = v12 + PAIRWISE PRODUCTS of 8 macro-band log-envelopes (28 pairs, raw + 1 multi-tau-60 = 56 features). log(env_a)*log(env_b) is QUADRATIC in the log-envelopes — genuinely NOT a linear function of any single band, so the ridge cannot synthesize these from existing log-env features. Encodes co-activation gating (harmonic structure, multi-formant resonance, sibilant broadband bursts). v12=0.0637 (best), v13=0.0632.

subject: patient1
description: v15 = v14 with TIME-LAGGED cross-band PRODUCTS added: macro_i(t) * macro_j(t-3) for full 8x8 matrix at lag k=3 frames (100ms — matches neural lag) = 64 features. Replaced v14's prod_pairs+tau (56) with prod_pairs (28) + lag_prod (64) = 92 total. The ridge has FIR delays but no cross-delay multiplications, so these temporal-conjunction features are genuinely new. v14=0.0642 (best), v12=0.0637.

subject: patient1
description: v16 = v14 base + CUBIC TRIPLE PRODUCTS of 8 macro-band log-envelopes: C(8,3) = 56 triples macro_i*macro_j*macro_k (i<j<k). Cubic terms are NOT expressible from linear+quadratic combinations of single bands, so genuinely new info for the ridge. Captures 3-way co-activation (F1+F2+F3 stack, broadband sibilant bursts). Dropped v14's prod_tau (28) to make budget. v14=0.0642 (best, +pairs), v15=0.0640 (+lag products neutral).

subject: patient1
description: v17 = v14 (pairs only, dropped tau) + ONSET x MACRO ENVELOPE cross-products: pool k=1 ONSET to 8 macro-bands, full 8x8 outer product with macro = 64 features. Multiplies a TEMPORAL HWR quantity (onset) by a STATIC amplitude (macro env). Captures phonetic events like voiced bursts (onset in formant regions AND broadband voicing energy). v14=0.0642 (best), v16=0.0642 (triples neutral). Testing a different FEATURE-TYPE product.

subject: patient1
description: v18 = v14 + TEMPORAL CONTRAST NORMALIZATION per band: log(env_lin) - log(lowpass(env_lin)) at taus 60 and 150 frames + HWR(+/-) of the tau=60 contrast (4*48=192 new features). The key nonlinearity: log(lowpass(env_lin)) is NOT lowpass(log(env)), so this CANNOT be recovered by the ridge from existing log-env multi-tau features. Captures cochlear AGC and STG loudness-adaptation analogue. Dropped TFS multi-tau-15 to free budget. v14=0.0642 (best), v17=0.0641 (cross-feature products neutral).

subject: patient1
description: v19 = v14 + CROSS-RATE MODULATION PRODUCTS per band: mod_filt[r=2Hz] * mod_filt[r=10Hz] (48 features). Genuinely quadratic in mod_filt features — the ridge has these rates as separate features but cannot multiply them. Captures syllable-boundary × consonant-release co-occurrence. Dropped 4 smaller blocks (formants 24, formant_d 6, spec_shape 3, flux 4 = 37) to make budget. v14=0.0642 (best), v18=0.0636.

subject: patient1
description: v20 = v14 with N_BANDS for analytic-signal (TFS) doubled from 32 to 48 (matching envelope). Finer pitch / IF resolution; TFS block now 703 features per multi-tau scale (was 495). Dropped fast TFS multi-tau (15) to fit budget. v14=0.0642 (best). Testing whether finer TFS band resolution yields more discriminative pitch / formant info for STG prediction.

subject: patient1
description: v21 = v14 minus ctx (per-band fixed-lag deltas at k=3/6/12 frames, 288 features dropped). Clean ablation experiment: does ctx carry signal beyond what the leaky-lowpass multi-tau and Gabor mod_filt already provide? If v21 >= v14, ctx is redundant and we can reclaim its 288-feature slot for more discriminative features in subsequent iterations. v14=0.0642 (best).

subject: patient1
description: v22 = v14 + SLIDING TEMPORAL MOMENTS per band: skew and kurt of log-envelope over a 15-frame (~500ms) sliding window, per band (48*2=96 features). Powers of centered values are genuinely nonlinear, not recoverable from the existing leaky-lowpass features. Captures envelope BURSTINESS / sustained-vs-punctate dynamics per band. Dropped Gabor rate 6 Hz to free budget. v14=0.0642 (best), v21=0.0621 (ctx ablation -0.002).

subject: patient1
description: v23 = v14 with PL mask REMOVED from IF/FM features (log_if, if_dev_norm, if_std, fm_up, fm_dn, corr_env_if). High-freq bands (F2 1.5-3kHz, F3 2-4kHz) now contribute formant-trajectory IF info to the ridge. PL mask kept on PLV features (phase coherence genuinely fails at high freq). No feature-count change. v14=0.0642 (best). Tests whether high-band FM info helps STG.

subject: patient1
description: v24 = v14 + CREST FACTOR per band: log(peak / RMS) within the 46ms inner window per band (32 features, gets multiplied by TFS multi-tau = 96 in total). Genuinely nonlinear (max + division). Captures within-frame burstiness — high for stop bursts and clicks, low for sustained vowels. Dropped Gabor rate 6Hz, formant_d, spec_shape, flux (61 features) to fit budget. v14=0.0642 (best), v22=0.0633, v23=0.0633.

subject: patient1
description: v25 = v14 with F_MAX extended from 6000 to 8000 Hz. Same number of bands (48 envelope, 32 TFS); spectrum re-stretched to cover sibilant frequencies (/s/, /sh/, /f/ have energy 4-8 kHz). No feature-count change; pure filterbank re-tuning. v14=0.0642 (best), v24=0.0638 (crest factor regressed).

subject: patient1
description: v26 = v25 with F_MAX pushed further from 8000 to 10000 Hz. Tests whether more high-freq coverage continues to help, or if we sacrifice mid-freq vowel resolution. v25=0.0645 (best), v14=0.0642.

subject: patient1
description: v27 = v26 with F_MAX pushed to 14000 Hz. v26 (F_MAX=10000) jumped +0.0023 over previous best — clearly high-freq coverage matters a lot. Pushing further to see how far this dimension carries. v26=0.0665 (best by far), v25=0.0645, v14=0.0642.

subject: patient1
description: v28 = v26 (F_MAX=10000) with N_BANDS_ENV doubled from 48 to 64. The wider spectrum needs finer resolution; each band now ~155 Hz wide instead of ~200. Affects env, ctx, mod_filt, li_rect, onsets blocks (all scale with N_BANDS_ENV). Dropped TFS multi-tau-15 to fit budget. v26=0.0665 (best), v27=0.0652 (F_MAX=14k too high).

subject: patient1
description: v29 = v26 with F_MAX=11000 (bisecting between v26=10000 (0.0665 best) and v27=14000 (0.0652 regressed)). Pure F_MAX sweep to find the sweet spot.

subject: patient1
description: v30 = v26 + F_MIN extended from 80 to 50 Hz. Captures low-pitched speakers' F0 (60-80 Hz) and very-low frequency vocal energy. Same band count, just stretched. v26=0.0665 (best), v29=0.0662 (F_MAX=11k same/worse), v28=0.0657 (N_BANDS_ENV=64 cost more than helped due to dropped TFS tau).

subject: patient1
description: v31 = v26 + INNER (TFS analysis window) doubled from 2048 to 4096 samples (46 ms -> 93 ms). IF/FM/PLV/PAC etc. averaged over 2x more samples — less noise, smoother estimates. Same feature count. v26=0.0665 (best F_MAX=10k).

subject: patient1
description: v32 = v26 with cube-root envelope DROPPED (cubeE — saves 288 features per frame). Tests whether cubeE adds anything beyond log envelope; both are compressive transforms of E. If v32 ~= v26, frees budget for richer spectrum (N_BANDS_ENV=64) in v33. v26=0.0665 (best F_MAX=10k).

subject: patient1
description: v33 = v32 (cubeE dropped) + N_BANDS_ENV doubled from 48 to 64. Finer spectral resolution across F_MAX=10000 Hz range — each band ~155 Hz wide. Affects env, ctx, mod_filt, li_rect, onsets blocks. Dropped Gabor rate 6Hz to fit budget. v32=0.0660 (cubeE ablation -0.0005 vs v26), v26=0.0665 (best).

subject: patient1
description: v34 = v26 + 1024 window RESTORED (was dropped in v12 for onset budget), but cubeE kept ONLY on the 4096 long window. Net feature count unchanged (192 envelope base): trade 2 cubeE blocks (96) for 1 extra logE window (48) and ... actually adds 48 features. Per frame: env now = 192 base + 2 tau + acausal. Net feature count match to v26. v26=0.0665 (best), v32=0.0660 (cubeE ablation -0.0005).

subject: patient1
description: v35 = v26 + macro × DoG-pooled-to-macros cross-products (8x8 = 64 features) — multiplies broadband macro envelope by formant-peak detection (positive DoG). Both feature types are present in v26; their product is genuinely quadratic and not derivable from either alone. Drops Gabor 6Hz to fit budget. v26=0.0665 (best, F_MAX=10k).
